messages.subject: spectro and dBref
parts:
Hello,

i found this nice package seewave and want to plot data, but not sound. I have a magnetometer recording from a drone flight. I want to plot the spectrogram, to differentiate from noise of the rotors and other anomalies. The function spectro() shows the right stuff, but the scale Amplitude (dB) is wrong. In the manual (spectro -> dBref) it says it uses a 20 mPa reference value. Which correction factor should i use to calculate from dB to, lets say tesla or nanoTesla? Or nothing logarithmical is suppose? Im very confused.

Thank you for your thoughts.
